All done. Here's a summary of what I did:

## Summary

**Problem:** checkout-api was failing health checks after the latest deploy (v2.3.1), with an 18% error rate and unhealthy status in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).

**Actions taken:**
1. **Investigated** — Checked service status and deployment history. Found v2.3.1 (latest) was unhealthy in production, while v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production.
2. **Rolled back** — Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. Rollback completed successfully.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident** — Created incident **INC-0002** ("checkout-api unhealthy after deploy of v2.3.1 - rolled back to v2.3.0"), which paged the on-call engineer. The first attempt timed out, so I retried with an idempotency key to guarantee exactly-once creation.

**Verification:** Post-rollback status confirms checkout-api is now on v2.3.0 in all regions, **healthy**, with error rate down to 0.2%.

**Note:** v2.3.1 remains the known-bad release — it should be investigated before any future redeploy attempt.
